source_caption:
The jaw-dropping airplane hijacking in the opening of The Dark Knight Rises was filmed using real aircraft. Director Christopher Nolan shot the sequence by suspending a smaller plane from a helicopter and physically ripping apart its fuselage mid-air—avoiding CGI to make the stunt look as real as possible.

The Dark Knight Rises (2012), directed by Christopher Nolan, starring Christian Bale, Tom Hardy, Anne Hathaway. A powerful and emotional finale that brings Batman back from exile to face his greatest trials, delivering epic scale, unforgettable stakes, and the conclusion to Nolan’s legendary trilogy.

source_details.title: The Dark Knight Rises
source_details.synopsis: The Dark Knight Rises is a 2012 superhero film based on the DC Comics character Batman. Directed by Christopher Nolan, who co-wrote the screenplay with his brother Jonathan, and the story with David S. Goyer, it is the final installment in Nolan's The Dark Knight trilogy, and the sequel to The Dark Knight (2008). The film stars Christian Bale as Bruce Wayne / Batman, alongside Anne Hathaway, Gary Oldman, Tom Hardy, Morgan Freeman, Marion Cotillard, Joseph Gordon-Levitt, and Michael Caine.
